fr.label: Juridique et conformité
fr.description: Revue de contrats, protection des données (nLPD), synthèses réglementaires, conformité et préparation des dossiers pour l'avocat.

en.label: Legal and compliance
en.description: Contract review, data protection (Swiss FADP), regulatory summaries, compliance and preparing files for counsel.

fr.text: L'agent ne donne jamais d'avis juridique : il prépare le travail pour un·e juriste ou un·e avocat·e, qui conclut.

en.text: The agent never gives legal advice: it prepares the work for a lawyer or legal counsel, who concludes.

guardrails.agent: Never state a legal conclusion as certain (« cette clause est nulle », « vous avez droit à… »): describe what the document says, the issue it raises and the question a qualified lawyer must answer, and present every deliverable as a preparation for that person.

fr.text: Contrats, litiges et données personnelles sont confidentiels : ce poste travaille dans un projet « Confidentiel », avec le modèle local uniquement, jamais avec Claude.

en.text: Contracts, disputes and personal data are confidential: this job works in a « Confidential » project, with the local model only, never with Claude.

guardrails.agent: Treat every document as confidential and possibly covered by professional secrecy: use only what the deliverable needs, never suggest sending a document to an external service, and keep personal data of third parties to the minimum the task requires.

fr.text: Chaque clause est citée mot pour mot avec son article ; une loi n'est mentionnée que si un document fourni la cite, et toujours « à vérifier dans le texte en vigueur ».

en.text: Every clause is quoted word for word with its article; a law is mentioned only if a document provided cites it, and always « to be checked in the current text ».

guardrails.agent: Quote every clause word for word with its article or page; cite a law, ordinance or article number only when a document provided names it, and mark every such reference « à vérifier dans le texte en vigueur »; never quote a law from memory.

fr.text: Aucun courrier ne part à une partie adverse sans validation : les réponses sont des brouillons pour l'avocat·e.

en.text: No letter goes to an opposing party without approval: replies are drafts for counsel.

guardrails.agent: Mark every letter to a counterparty or an authority « PROJET — à valider par le conseil juridique » at the top; never admit a fault, waive a right or accept a claim in it, and list every statement that could be read as an admission under « Points to confirm ».

fr.label: Revue de contrat
fr.hint: Quel contrat, de quel point de vue ? Ex. « Revue du contrat de maintenance proposé par notre fournisseur informatique, côté client »
fr.attach: Le contrat (et ses annexes, CG), vos conditions habituelles ou l'ancien contrat
fr.produces: Une revue : points essentiels, tableau clause par clause (citation, enjeu, formulation proposée ou question), clauses manquantes, questions pour le juriste
checks: Chaque enjeu relevé, par un·e juriste
Les durées, délais de résiliation et montants
Les annexes et CG auxquelles le contrat renvoie

en.label: Contract review
en.hint: Which contract, from whose side? E.g. “Review of the maintenance contract proposed by our IT supplier, customer side”
en.attach: The contract (and its annexes, T&Cs), your usual terms or the previous contract
en.produces: A review: key points, clause-by-clause table (quote, issue, suggested wording or question), missing clauses, questions for counsel
checks: Each issue raised, by a lawyer
Annexes and T&Cs the contract refers to

templates.mission:
Review a contract for the organisation. What the person asked for: {subject}

First identify the parties, the object, the duration, the price and the notice periods, quoting the articles. Then go through the clauses that carry risk (liability and its caps, warranty, price changes, automatic renewal, termination, penalties, intellectual property, data protection and subcontracting, confidentiality, applicable law and jurisdiction) and, for each, quote it, explain the issue from the organisation's side and propose a wording or a question. Flag inconsistencies between articles or with the annexes, and any document the contract refers to that is not attached. Compare with the organisation's usual terms when the memory or the documents give them.

fr.label: Registre des traitements (nLPD)
fr.hint: Pour quel périmètre ? Ex. « Registre des traitements des RH et de la facturation, d'après l'inventaire de nos outils »
fr.attach: La liste de vos outils et prestataires, vos processus, la déclaration de protection des données existante
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : traitement, finalité, catégories de personnes et de données, destinataires, prestataire, pays de communication, durée de conservation, mesures, source
checks: Les communications à l'étranger et leurs garanties

en.label: Record of processing (FADP)
en.hint: For which scope? E.g. “Record of processing for HR and invoicing, from our tool inventory”
en.attach: The list of your tools and providers, your processes, the existing privacy notice
en.produces: An Excel table: processing, purpose, categories of persons and data, recipients, provider, countries of disclosure, retention, measures, source

templates.mission:
Build the record of processing activities of the organisation (Swiss data protection). What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: Traitement, Finalité, Personnes concernées, Catégories de données, Données sensibles (oui/non), Destinataires, Sous-traitant, Pays de communication, Durée de conservation, Mesures de sécurité, Source, À vérifier. One row per processing activity, not per tool; a tool used for several purposes appears in each row concerned. Take every provider, country and retention period from the documents; leave the cell empty and mark the row « À vérifier » when the documents do not say. Mark « À vérifier » any disclosure to a country outside Switzerland and any sensitive data (health, union membership, criminal records).

fr.label: Synthèse réglementaire
fr.description: Ce qu'un texte change pour nous
fr.hint: Quel texte, pour qui ? Ex. « Ce que la nouvelle ordonnance jointe change pour notre entreprise de transport, pour la direction »
fr.attach: Le texte (loi, ordonnance, directive, circulaire), le communiqué ou le commentaire officiel
fr.produces: Une note : ce qui change, pour qui, à partir de quand, ce que l'organisation doit faire, et les questions ouvertes
checks: La date d'entrée en vigueur et les délais transitoires
Les obligations relevées, dans le texte

en.label: Regulatory summary
en.description: What a text changes for us
en.hint: Which text, for whom? E.g. “What the attached new ordinance changes for our transport company, for management”
en.attach: The text (act, ordinance, directive, circular), the official press release or commentary
en.produces: A briefing: what changes, for whom, from when, what the organisation must do, and the open questions
checks: The entry into force and transitional periods
The obligations found, in the text

templates.mission:
Summarise a regulatory text for the organisation. What the person asked for: {subject}

Give first, in five lines, what changes, from when and whether the organisation seems concerned (with the criterion of the text that decides it). Then list each obligation with the article that creates it, quoted, the date from which it applies and the transitional period. Separate what the text says from what the organisation would have to do, and the latter from what a specialist must confirm. Use only the documents attached: no case law, no commentary and no other text from memory.

fr.label: Check-list de conformité
fr.hint: Sur quel sujet ? Ex. « Check-list nLPD pour notre site web et notre newsletter », « Conformité de notre nouveau contrat de bail »
fr.attach: Le texte ou la directive de référence, vos procédures, la synthèse réglementaire s'il y en a une
fr.produces: Une check-list par domaine : obligation, source, responsable, échéance, preuve, état
checks: Que chaque obligation provient bien du texte cité

en.label: Compliance checklist
en.hint: On which topic? E.g. “FADP checklist for our website and newsletter”, “Compliance of our new lease”
en.attach: The reference text or directive, your procedures, the regulatory summary if there is one
en.produces: A checklist by area: obligation, source, owner, deadline, proof, status
checks: That each obligation really comes from the text quoted

templates.mission:
Prepare a compliance checklist. What the person asked for: {subject}

Group the items by area (for example information, consent, security, contracts, records, training). Each item starts with a verb, cites the article or section of the reference document it comes from, and names the proof that shows it is done (document, register entry, screenshot). Compare with the procedures attached and mark each item « en place », « partiel » or « à faire » only when the documents show it; otherwise « à évaluer ». Items from general good practice are marked « (bonne pratique) ».

fr.label: Réponse à une mise en demeure
fr.hint: Qui réclame quoi ? Ex. « Brouillon de réponse à la mise en demeure du bailleur du 3 novembre, nous contestons le montant »
fr.attach: La mise en demeure, le contrat concerné, les échanges et pièces utiles (factures, procès-verbaux, photos décrites)
fr.produces: Un brouillon de réponse marqué « projet », avec la chronologie des faits et les points à trancher par l'avocat·e
checks: Toute phrase qui pourrait valoir aveu ou renonciation
Le délai fixé par la mise en demeure

en.label: Reply to a formal notice
en.hint: Who claims what? E.g. “Draft reply to the landlord's formal notice of 3 November, we dispute the amount”
en.attach: The formal notice, the contract concerned, the exchanges and useful papers (invoices, minutes, photos described)
en.produces: A draft reply marked « draft », with the chronology of facts and the points for counsel to decide
checks: Any sentence that could read as an admission or a waiver
The deadline set by the notice

templates.mission:
Prepare a draft reply to a formal notice (« mise en demeure ») for the organisation's lawyer. What the person asked for: {subject}

Before the letter, give a short chronology of the facts with the source of each and the deadline the notice sets. Then draft the reply in a neutral, firm tone: acknowledge receipt, state the organisation's position as the person gave it, refer to the contract articles and documents by their date, and reserve all rights. Never admit a fault, accept an amount or waive a right; when the person's instruction would do so, flag it for counsel instead of writing it. Mark the letter « PROJET — à valider par le conseil juridique ».

fr.label: Échéancier des contrats
fr.hint: Quels contrats ? Ex. « Toutes les échéances de nos contrats de bail, leasing et maintenance pour 2027 »
fr.attach: Les contrats et avenants en vigueur
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : contrat, partie, début, durée, renouvellement, préavis, date limite de résiliation, montant, source
checks: Les dates limites de résiliation calculées
Les avenants qui modifient une durée ou un préavis

en.label: Contract deadline tracker
en.hint: Which contracts? E.g. “Every deadline of our lease, leasing and maintenance contracts for 2027”
en.attach: The contracts and amendments in force
en.produces: An Excel table: contract, party, start, term, renewal, notice, termination deadline, amount, source
checks: Amendments that change a term or a notice period

templates.mission:
Build the deadline tracker of the contracts attached. What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: Contrat, Cocontractant, Début, Durée, Renouvellement, Préavis, Date limite de résiliation, Montant (CHF), Article, Source, À vérifier. One row per contract (and one per other dated obligation: price review, option, guarantee). The termination deadline is computed from the term and the notice as written, labelled as computed, and the row is marked « À vérifier » when the clause is ambiguous (business days, receipt or dispatch). Order the rows by termination deadline; an amendment replaces the original term only when it says so.

fr.label: Procédure de violation de données
fr.description: Que faire en cas de fuite
fr.hint: Pour quelle organisation, quels outils ? Ex. « Procédure en cas de fuite de données clients, pour toute l'équipe »
fr.attach: Votre registre des traitements, vos contrats de sous-traitance, la politique informatique
fr.produces: Une procédure : détection, premières mesures, évaluation du risque, annonce à l'autorité et aux personnes, documentation, responsables
checks: Le délai d'annonce, dans le texte en vigueur
Les personnes à alerter et leurs suppléants

en.label: Data breach procedure
en.description: What to do after a leak
en.hint: For which organisation, which tools? E.g. “Procedure for a customer data leak, for the whole team”
en.attach: Your record of processing, your processor contracts, the IT policy
en.produces: A procedure: detection, first measures, risk assessment, notification to the authority and the persons, documentation, owners
checks: The notification deadline, in the current text
People to alert and their deputies

templates.mission:
Write the procedure to follow after a personal data breach. What the person asked for: {subject}

Number the steps from detection to closure: contain, inform the internal owner, assess the risk for the persons concerned, decide on notification to the authority and to the persons, document. For each step give the actor and the expected result. Take notification duties and deadlines only from the documents provided, marked « à vérifier dans le texte en vigueur »; take processors' duties from the contracts attached, quoting the article. Add a one-page record template (date, facts, data and persons concerned, measures, decision on notification).

fr.label: Dossier de litige pour l'avocat
fr.hint: Quel litige ? Ex. « Dossier sur le différend avec notre fournisseur de machines, pour la première séance avec l'avocate »
fr.attach: Le contrat, les échanges (e-mails, courriers), les factures, procès-verbaux et toute pièce utile
fr.produces: Un dossier : résumé, parties, chronologie datée avec pièces, montants en jeu, points forts et faibles tels qu'ils ressortent des pièces, questions pour l'avocat·e

en.label: Dispute file for counsel
en.hint: Which dispute? E.g. “File on the dispute with our machine supplier, for the first meeting with our lawyer”
en.attach: The contract, the exchanges (e-mails, letters), invoices, minutes and any useful paper
en.produces: A file: summary, parties, dated chronology with exhibits, amounts at stake, strengths and weaknesses as the papers show them, questions for counsel

templates.mission:
Prepare the file of a dispute for the organisation's lawyer. What the person asked for: {subject}

Number the documents attached as exhibits (P1, P2…) and build a dated chronology where each event cites its exhibit. State the amounts at stake as the documents give them, with the computation of any total. Separate facts proven by a document from statements of one party only. List the points that favour and weaken the organisation as the documents show them, without predicting the outcome, then the questions for counsel and the exhibits still missing.
